scope: Fixed December 2019 and two approved four-month blocks; no feature, KPI or return calculation
billing_basis: All three currently linked billing-account projects returned complete October job inventories with zero jobs. Billing remains enabled; two no-cost administrative APIs enabled for inspection. Account identifiers and original responses remain private. This is a current-project usage inventory, not a billing invoice or guarantee about unrelated future usage.

queries.name: dec2019_sample_v001
queries.sql:
SELECT date, client, page, root_page, wptid, technologies,
JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.result') AS result,
JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.date') AS actual_test_epoch,
JSON_VALUE(payload, '$.lib-detector-version') AS library_detector_version,
TO_JSON_STRING(metadata) AS source_metadata
FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages`
WHERE date = '2019-12-01' AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page
ORDER BY SHA256(root_page), wptid LIMIT 20

queries.name: 2020_block_neutral_v001
queries.sql: SELECT date, client, page, root_page, wptid, technologies FROM `httparchive.crawl.pages` WHERE date IN ('2020-01-01','2020-02-01','2020-03-01','2020-04-01') AND client = 'desktop' AND is_root_page QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY date ORDER BY SHA256(root_page), wptid) <= 20
